name: TrollIsland
tagline: 为 iOS 16–18 带来原生灵动岛，并提供空闲隐藏与位置调节。
description: TrollIsland 为更多 iPhone 带来原生灵动岛体验，支持 iOS 16 至 iOS 18。
你可以根据系统版本使用空闲隐藏、机型样式和位置调节等功能。
iOS 16 支持目前为实验性，仅提供灵动岛显示，无法通过计时器、录音、录屏等活动触发灵动岛操作。
features: 支持 iOS 16–18 启用原生灵动岛
iOS 18 支持透明空闲状态与位置预览
提供多种机型显示样式
通过滑块或数值输入调整灵动岛垂直位置
一键重置位置，保存前保持草稿状态
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的 TrollIsland。
选择适合设备的显示样式；iOS 16/17 可按需开启「不用时隐藏」。
逐步调整垂直偏移，直到胶囊与内容完整可见。
点击“保存配置”；iOS 18 会提供短暂的位置预览，启用灵动岛或切换机型时按提示注销桌面。

changes: 修复灵动岛偶发闪烁问题。
增强 iOS 16/17「不用时隐藏」的稳定性。
增强 iOS 16 实验性兼容性。
新增 iOS 18 灵动岛支持与位置预览。
新增 iOS 16/17「不用时隐藏」功能。
修复部分场景下的闪烁问题，并增强空闲状态与位置调整稳定性。
改善 iOS 16 至 iOS 18 的兼容性。

en.name: TrollIsland
en.tagline: Bring the native Dynamic Island to iOS 16–18 with idle hiding and position controls.
description: TrollIsland brings the native Dynamic Island experience to more iPhones on iOS 16 through iOS 18.
Use idle hiding, device styles, and position controls according to your iOS version.
iOS 16 support is experimental and currently provides display only; activities such as timers, recording, and screen recording cannot trigger Dynamic Island interactions.
features: Enable the native Dynamic Island on iOS 16–18
Hide the island when idle on iOS 16 and iOS 17
Transparent idle state and position preview on iOS 18
Adjust vertical position with a slider or numeric input
Reset position with one tap while keeping changes as a draft until saved
usage: Open TrollIsland in Settings after installation.
Choose a display style for your device; on iOS 16 and iOS 17, enable idle hiding if desired.
Adjust the vertical offset gradually until the island and its content remain fully visible.
Tap Save Configuration; iOS 18 provides a brief position preview, and enabling the island or changing device style may require a SpringBoard restart.

changes: Improved idle-hiding stability on iOS 16 and iOS 17.
Added iOS 18 Dynamic Island support and position preview.
Added idle hiding on iOS 16 and iOS 17.
Fixed flickering in some situations and improved idle-state and position stability.
Improved compatibility across iOS 16 through iOS 18.
